changes: TERMINAL_SUCCESS now requires at least one positive validation PASS and evidence for PASS/SKIPPED validation entries.
Task Authorization Records can name required validation and CI gates; pair validation requires PASS/SUCCESS for those gates.
Pull-request CI now compares the real Git diff against the Task Authorization mutation_scope and fails closed on out-of-scope files.
Added durable Recovery Checkpoint schema and recovery protocol integration with bounded attempt/no-progress counters.
Added exact-revision Human-Gate transition authorization/result schemas and validation.
Recorded the historical PR #4 merge as HISTORICAL_OBSERVED with no invented authorization record.
Updated four-role fallback documentation, control-plane docs, internal roles, and Project Leader/Recovery Guardian plugin contracts.
